notes.title: NEW MENU PLUS ENITITY UPDATE
notes.content: [p]A new menu has been added with full controller support and expanded options for adjusting graphics, video settings, color, and more. We've also introduced a [b]Level Select[/b] feature, allowing players to explore all levels without any entities—perfect for those who want to freely explore the game world.[/p][p]Additional updates include:[/p][list][*][p]A voiced [b]Game Intro[/b], now featuring a voice actor.[/p][/*][*][p]Various [b]bug fixes[/b] and [b]map changes[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zoom functionality[/b] has been improved to zoom in more quickly.[/p][/*][/list]
